text: 3-month-old boy. The parents report that the rash has been present for several weeks, noting that it sometimes appears red and scaly, especially during cold weather. speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Seborrheic Dermatitis (Cradle Cap)
Based on the patient being a 3-month-old infant with a red, scaly rash that worsens in cold weather and a family history of psoriasis, I suspect seborrheic dermatitis, though I need to rule out psoriasis. REQUEST IMAGES: Scalp and forehead rash photos.
